text: CONSIDERING file Number 020-003060/2000 of the Registry of the MINISTRY OF ECONOMY and the Bill registered under number 25326, enacted by the NATIONAL CONGRESS on October 4, 2000, and
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: The above mentioned Bill provides for integral protection of personal data, in accordance with the provisions of Article 43, third paragraph of the NATIONAL CONSTITUTION.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: Article 29 of the Bill sets forth the creation of an Oversight Authority to take any and all necessary steps for compliance with purposes and provisions included in such Bill.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: SubArticle 2 of such Article sets forth that the Oversight Authority shall serve independently and shall act as decentralized agency within the scope of the MINISTRY OF JUSTICE AND HUMAN RIGHTS.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: SubArticle 3 of Article 29 of the Bill governs the conduct and management of such Oversight Authority.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: The creation of the Oversight Authority as a decentralized agency shall imply, as any creation of a organization structure of its kind, an increase of expenditure for the NATIONAL STATE.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That this Act does not provide for financing of the Oversight Authority and Act Number 25237: National Government Budget for fiscal year 2000 and National Budget Act for fiscal year 2001 do not contain any credit allocations therefor.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That laws in force regulating Public Financial Management provide that any spending increase shall provide for its respective financing.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That, notwithstanding the above, the creation of an oversight authority is deemed relevant, but such competent authority shall comply with organizational characteristics set forth by the EXECUTIVE BRANCH as authorized by Article 45 of this Bill.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That Article 47 of the Bill sets forth that databases delivering credit information services shall delete or, if applicable, not include, any data referring to non-compliance or default in payment of an obligation, if such obligation has been settled on the effective date of this Act.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That this decision would imply the loss of historical information related to credit compliance of many system debtors, which could produce a cost increase in bank credit operations originated in the higher risk caused by uncertainty.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That, according to the reasons above, we must observe Article 29, subArticles 2 and 3 and Article 47 of the Bill registered under the Number 25,326.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That the proposed measure does not alter the spirit or consistency of the Bill enacted by the NATIONAL CONGRESS.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That the GENERAL OFFICE OF LEGAL AFFAIRS of the MINISTRY OF ECONOMY has been involved as applicable.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

text: That the EXECUTIVE BRANCH is empowered to enact this Bill by virtue of the provisions of Article 80 of the NATIONAL CONSTITUTION.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf
